title: Identifying and Manipulating Personality Traits in LLMs Through Activation Engineering

bias_targets.methodology: Applying dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP) and K-means clustering on activation vectors to measure the proximity and entanglement between benign or positive personality traits (e.g., confident, competitive) and socially undesirable/harmful traits (e.g., manipulative, vindictive, psychopathic).
